name: Drdo Rustom 2 Uav
operating_principle: The DRDO Rustom-2 is a medium-altitude long-endurance unmanned aerial vehicle that uses two NPO Saturn 36MT turboprop engines to generate power, allowing it to fly for up to 24 hours at a maximum speed of 225 km/h. It is designed for aerial surveillance and can carry various payloads, including electronic intelligence systems and situational awareness systems.

components.description: The main structural body of the aircraft
T-shaped tail assembly that provides stability
Tricycle nose wheel type retractable landing gear system
Houses the two NPO Saturn 36MT turboprop engines
Carries various payloads, including electronic intelligence systems and situational awareness systems
